value.title: Il fantasma verde
value.synopsis: Several construction labor units at the site of a planned road have been destroyed. Noa, Asuma, and Hiromi are sent to investigate. Some are quick to blame a local legend for the mayhem.

value.title: Il Labor rosso
value.synopsis: Noa and Asuma are sent to investigate a terrorist who is going to steal a military labor of the Soviet Armed Forces.

value.title: La trappola di Natale
value.synopsis: Kanuka's grandma from Hawaii visits Tokyo for Christmas. Then she suddenly disappears. The only clue to find her is "The Christmas of 50 years ago". When they try to find her, they are called off to duty.

value.title: Natale di terrore
value.synopsis: Kanuka's grandma is still missing. Shinshi and some guy is sent to go find her. Kanuka uses Ota's labor to help Noa in the mission.

value.title: Il confuso pomeriggio di Ota
value.synopsis: Ota is having an arranged marriage. Noa and the others help Ota out on his dates.

value.title: Siate gentile, Vostra Altezza
value.synopsis: A prince from a desert country joins Division 2 for a couple of days so he can establish a labor team in his homeland. A sniper is out to kill the prince, so Division 2 goes to stop him.

value.title: Vinci tu!
value.synopsis: Goto takes Division 2 out for drinks as a team building excercise.

value.title: Il canto della balena
value.synopsis: An endangered humpback whale enters the Tokyo Bay. The city and Division 2 try to get the whale to leave the bay and go back to the ocean.

value.title: Missione a Hokkaido
value.synopsis: Noa's hometown is having a snow festival and Division 2 is helping out. They also try to help out a boy named Satoru who hates labors.

value.title: Obiettivo: capitano Goto
value.synopsis: Goto starts to act very strangely lately. Also, there are a lot of random attacks coming at Goto. Could these attacks have anything to do why Goto is acting strangely?

value.title: Mi piaci, signorina Noa
value.synopsis: A famous entertainer named Kana is joining Division 2 for one week. Everybody is trying to teach Kana how to pilot a labor. A crime gang tries to kidnap Kana so they can get one of Division 2's ingrams. However, they accidently steal Noa. Now, they have to save Noa without having to give the gang one of their ingrams.

value.title: L'ombra del terrore
value.synopsis: A terrorist planted a bomb in Geo-City. Division 2 is tasked with disarming it. Kanuka and Noa are put on the mission.

value.title: Un'oscura minaccia all'orizzonte
value.synopsis: Noa and Asuma get into a fight concerning Asuma's personal life. When Division 2 get's assigned a special mission, Asuma is sent to Hajioji to pick up Unit 3.

value.title: Il ritorno del Phantom
value.synopsis: Asuma heads to Hajioji to recover Unit 3. In the meantime, Noa and Ota are having trouble keeping the enemy at bay.

value.title: Fiori e Labor
value.synopsis: Noa's and Kanuka's labor skills attract the attention of a wealthy individual.

value.title: Il rapporto di Kanuka
value.synopsis: Kanuka is now leaving Division 2 and going back home to America. Asuma, Ota, and the others decide to throw her a farewell party. Noa is sent to spy on Kanuka. When the guys finish setting up the party, they come across Kanuka's reports on Division 2 and decide to read them.

value.title: Addio, Kanuka
value.synopsis: Kanuka is heading back to America. However, there is a hijacker trying to hijack the plane Kanuka is riding on. How is Kanuka going to stop this, and without her gun?

value.title: Tempesta primaverile
value.synopsis: Shinshi takes control of Kanuka's position in Division 2. However, he is really bad at it. Then, he is offered a new job. Will Shinshi stay with Division 2 or will he take the new job? And how is his wife going to react?

value.title: Sono Takeo Kumagami
value.synopsis: Takeo Kumagami now joins Division 2. Noa is worried that Goto will reassign positions and that Takeo will take her place as the pilot for Unit 1.

value.title: Voci dall'oscurità
value.synopsis: SV2 is training in an old abandoned mansion. After a while, several members of the team encounter seemingly supernatural phenomena.

value.title: La strana coppia
value.synopsis: Noa and Asuma meet a strange duo at an arcade. Later, a strange and powerful labor is revealed.

value.title: La distruzione della Seconda Sezione Veicoli Speciali
value.synopsis: SV2 orders their lunch from Shanghai Restraunt, as usual. But they never get it. They intend to find out why and won't work until they get their food.

value.title: Arriva il Griffon
value.synopsis: Utsumi plans to unveil the Griffon to the public. Meanwhile, H.Q. wants to stand up additional labor divisions, planning to replace the Ingrams with a more economic model.

value.title: Tragedia nella pioggia
value.synopsis: Division 2 is on duty at the International Labor Show. Asuma takes Noa's movement disk to test out the new economy model. But then, the Griffon is unleashed. He beats up Asuma and Ota. Noa enters the fight after getting her disk back, but the Griffon retreats since it was raining.

value.title: Il ritorno di Kanuka
value.synopsis: The Griffon has crashed and Noa is relieved. However, the Griffon is being fixed up. Kanuka comes back to Tokyo and temporarily takes control of command of Unit 1.

value.title: I cani della Shaft
value.synopsis: Noa and the gang that the Griffon didn't really crash, the crash was faked. SCHAFT must not let Utsumi get to Tokyo, but he gets there. Noa must prepare for the fight against the Griffon.

value.title: Battaglia al portone del castello
value.synopsis: Noa and Alphonse begin the fight with Bud and the Griffon. Noa is given a rifle to use but she can't use it because there are stupid people in the way. She tries using it like a sword but it didn't work out.

value.title: Il destino del Griffon
value.synopsis: Noa and Alphonse continue her fight with the Griffon. But the Griffon gets away in order for Utsumi to escape. Kanuka must go back to America.

value.title: L'avventura di Noa
value.synopsis: Division 2 goes to stay by the mountains for a week for training. While out buying dinner, Noa finds 20,000 yen and goes to find where the money came from all by herself.

value.title: Serenità in vendita
value.synopsis: Division 2 must get the Patlabor Insurance to cover for the cars they destroyed.

value.title: Viaggio nel sottosuolo
value.synopsis: Something is out stealing stuff from Division 2. It appears to come from an old tunnel. Ota and Shinshi go to check it out. When Division 2 loses contact with them, Noa, Asuma, Hiromi, and Takeo go to find them.

value.title: Un nuovo Labor
value.synopsis: Shinohara Industries has finished the new production model of a police labor. Noa, Ota, and Gomioka tests them. What will they think of them?

value.title: Gli ordini della guardia costiera
value.synopsis: People claim to have seen some kind of monster on the beach. Division 2 investigates this.

value.title: Salvate i terroristi
value.synopsis: Division 2 must save 2 very lousy terrorists that set off a bomb in the wrong place.

value.title: Quelli che ritornano
value.synopsis: Three old terrorists team up to steal some money.

value.title: Donne al lavoro
value.synopsis: Momoko Sakurayama is interviewing Noa for "The Working Girl" show. Meanwhile, a sick man steals a labor in order to commit suicide.

value.title: Lunga vita al CLAT
value.synopsis: Shige is being sent to New York. However, he gets hurt before he goes and has a dream that he is in New York working with CLAT.

value.title: La scelta di Noa
value.synopsis: Noa is offered to become a pilot for a Helldiver. While Noa tries to make her decision, she must stop a criminal without Alphonse.

value.title: Il suo nome è Zero
value.synopsis: SV2 gets a new patlabor model called the Zero. It is superior to the ingram. After messing up during a mission, Noa is worried that she will lose Alphonse.

value.title: Luci verdi
value.synopsis: Noa goes back to her hometown and sees the grave of her dog Alphonse. Asuma goes to get her when a terrorist comes. Division 1 and 2 must find the terrorist without using weapons since it would cause a fire.
